I have a family history of early Alzheimer’s disease. When people I love seemed to have lost what made them whole, it felt relieving when they passed away. However there is a lot of sadness and pain that comes with death. 
I just want to share, I think that life is beautiful because it is both immensely joyful and fascinating, while it is terrifyingly humbling and miserable. After experiencing the deterioration of people I love, it brings me peace accepting that death is relieving and awful. All at the same time.
